msg: Hi! We're a family from Ohio visiting Cartagena next week: my husband and I are certified divers (Open Water, 2023), and our kids are 8 and 14. What could we do together in a day?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely family day in the Rosario Islands! You can combine activities in the same tour: you and your husband can do the certified 2-dive trip, your 8-year-old can try Bubble Makers, and your 14-year-old can snorkel or do the Dive Mini Course if they’d like to try diving. The 14-year-old meets the minimum age for the mini-course.

Online prices include the 10% discount. Bubble Makers’ schedule and transfer details are arranged by an advisor, and mixed activities may be split between boats depending on the group.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 168 USD · 187 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 123 USD · 137 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. Thanks! Honestly the Dive Mini Course sounds too much for our 14-year-old, she's a bit nervous. We'd rather have her snorkel. And our 8-year-old - Bubble Makers sounds intense, can he just snorkel too?
reply:
Absolutely—both kids can snorkel instead. Snorkeling is available from age 6, so it’s a great option for your 8- and 14-year-olds. Bubble Makers is optional; it’s a gentle introduction in a pool or very shallow water, up to 2 m, with a dedicated instructor. Your family can combine snorkeling with certified diving on the same day, though the snorkeling and diving may take place in different areas.

The 10% online discount is included in those prices. You can book the snorkeling here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD

If you'd like, I can help you book it: *Dive mini-course*. Shall we? 🌊

msg: No, not the mini course, we decided on snorkeling for both kids. So the total would be 2 Fun Dives for us and 2 snorkeling for the kids, all from Cartagena? What's the total and how do we book?
reply:
Yes—2 Fun Dives for you and 2 Snorkeling Tours for the kids, all departing from Cartagena.

Both activities meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and include boat transport and lunch. The snorkeling tour includes two guided snorkeling sessions.

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
